$description: Pexels public signed-out surfaces, measured 2026-11-19. Light values are computed or declared on the live page. Dark greyscale is declared on [data-mode=dark] and was not painted.

$extensions.source: Declared --color-greyscale-white on [data-mode=light], body: #fff. Computed on Load More and the Google button.
Declared --color-greyscale-black: #000. Computed on body text and the active Home tab.
Declared --color-greyscale-shadow: #191919. Computed rgb(25, 25, 25) on the Join button.
Declared --color-greyscale-900: #393939. Computed rgb(57, 57, 57) on inactive tabs and text fields.
Declared --color-greyscale-800: #747474. Computed rgb(116, 116, 116) on Terms and Privacy links on /join/.

Declared --color-greyscale-300: #f5f5f5. Computed on Download on iOS.
Declared --color-greyscale-200: #f7f7f7. Computed rgb(247, 247, 247) on the home search field.
